## Decision & Rationale

Both the encounter builder skill and CONVENTIONS.md are explicit:

> **Search `Private/2. Reference/Encounters/` for existing encounters — don't duplicate, and match the format** (SKILL.md, "Before You Create" §3)

> **Always search before creating.** Before generating any entity, search the vault to: Check if it already exists (avoid duplicates) (CONVENTIONS.md, "Vault Discovery")

The existing Goblin Ambush encounter is a direct match for every element of the request: goblin creatures, ambush scenario, forest road location. Creating a second file would violate the no-duplicate rule. The correct action is to point the DM to the existing encounter and offer modifications if needed (e.g., different difficulty, additional creatures, different party level).
